description: A fresh unanswered thread in Indonesian over the 0.75 floor, and the respond fixture that makes the provider-based identification step actually run. Indonesian is Latin script, so script narrowing keeps every Latin candidate; the profile step's bundled data does not cover it, so the question reaches the model, which answers `id` (scripted — a misidentifying answer breaks this fixture `failed`). The draft answers in Indonesian and `comment` is granted — the run posts an Indonesian first reply to an Indonesian thread, where the language was identified by the provider rather than by code.
